programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    separator_cells = set()
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1:
            separator_cells.update((r, c) for c in range(w))
    for c in range(w):
        if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1:
            separator_cells.update((r, c) for r in range(h))
    for r, c in separator_cells:
        out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
